purpose: Frozen, one-time final-test evaluation of saved checkpoints. No retraining, no re-selection, no threshold optimisation.

evaluation_code.note: Evaluation code is fingerprinted separately; historical TRAINING code lineage is the git tags in `sources`.

policy.checkpoints: recorded best_model_state.pt (best_round from the selection partition) and last_model_state.pt (round 30)
policy.thresholds: recorded calibration-partition thresholds only; never recomputed or optimised on test data
policy.preprocessing: saved training-fitted preprocessor.joblib is loaded; never refitted
policy.decision_rule: score >= threshold on raw probabilities (repaired src/metrics.py)
policy.operational_flag: test FPR at the primary threshold > 0.25 is reported as a threshold-policy failure; no repair
